text:
Omar Ruiz: Hi team, accepted the org invite to omar@redwood.com but GitHub shows 'SAML SSO: Authorization required' when I try to access private repos. I completed the SSO web flow and approved the app but access still blocked. Anyone seen this exact message? :thinking:

Leah Foster: Welcome Omar! Sometimes that happens if your GitHub account has multiple verified emails and the org mapping picked a different one. Can you paste your GitHub username?

Omar Ruiz: username is omar-ruiz. When I go to a private repo it shows a yellow banner: 'Access to this repository is restricted. Request access' and the SAML page points at the org's SSO page with a button 'Authorize SAML'. I already clicked authorize.

infra-bot: Note: Organization requires SAML SSO and the account must be authorized for the org. If the account was authorized before but a verified email mismatch exists, automatic team mapping can fail.

people-ops: Hi Omar 44b3fb I'm checking the invite logs. It looks like when you accepted the invite you had two verified emails on the account (omar.work@gmail.com and omar.personal@gmail.com) and the org mapping ended up linking to the personal one. That explains why SSO doesn't grant repo access. Do you want us to remap to omar@redwood.com or would you prefer to add your work email to the account and we can remap automatically?

Omar Ruiz: I'd rather not add work email to personal account. Please remap to omar@redwood.com.

Leah Foster: We'll revoke the current association and reissue the invite to omar@redwood.com. Quick FYI: when accepting the new invite, complete the SAML SSO step and then sign out of GitHub and sign back in to flush sessions.

people-ops: Re-sent invite to omar@redwood.com and set for enforced SAML. Omar, accept in a desktop browser and when prompted hit 'Authorize SAML' and then sign out and back in. It should land you in the right account.

Omar Ruiz: Accepted and did the sign-out/in dance. Now I can view private repos but when I try to push I get a 403 and the web UI shows I have 'Read' on the repo, not 'Write'. The team membership says pending. :confused:

Leah Foster: Looks like automatic team mapping didn't run after the remap. Sometimes there's a short queue. I'm going to manually add you to teams: dev-platform and infra so you get write access. That will grant push rights.

people-ops: Added Omar to teams dev-platform, infra. Should be effective now. Note: if branch protection requires an additional approval team, you might still not be able to push to protected branches, but feature branch pushes should work.

Omar Ruiz: Can confirm `git push` succeeded after the team add, but small wrinkle: my local git was configured with the personal account credentials cached in the OS credential helper so the first push attempt still tried the wrong creds and errored before prompting. Cleared and re-auth'd. Steps I followed: 

```bash
# remove cached creds (macOS example)
git credential-osxkeychain erase 
protocol=https
host=github.com
# or use gh to login
gh auth login --hostname github.com --web
```

That fixed it.

infra-bot: Additional note: if you use VS Code GitHub extension, sign out and sign in with the work account after SAML. The extension can retain tokens tied to the old account.

Omar Ruiz: One last question  the repo's CI checks require a signed commit for some infra repos. My git user.email is my personal one. Does that affect signed commits or is it just the GPG key?

Leah Foster: Commit signature verification uses the GPG/SSH key used to sign, not the author email. However repo attribution and CLA bots sometimes look at the author email. Set per-repo email with: `git config user.email "omar@redwood.com"` and if you need to sign with GPG, follow the handbook steps to add a GPG key to GitHub.

Omar Ruiz: Thanks everyone. Suggestion: add a note in the onboarding flow about multiple verified emails causing SSO mapping problems and to always accept reissued invites from the work email on desktop. Would have saved a couple back-and-forths.

people-ops: Great suggestion  we'll add it to the invite text. Welcome to Redwood, Omar! :tada:

DevPlatform Bot: If anyone else hits 'SAML SSO: Authorization required' after accepting the invite, please DM people-ops with your GitHub username and the invite email and we'll remediate.
